messages:
maya: Scanner flagged a Vault-wrap header inside a partner-uploaded artifact. path: s3://partner-uploads/redwood/2026-03-22/build-1102/artifact.tgz :exclamation:
leo: wrapped or raw token?
maya: wrapped header only. looks like: 'BEGIN VAULT TOKEN -- wrapped:true,kms:key-id=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/ci-wrap'
scans-bot: automated scan -> high severity secret detected in artifact.tgz (scan-id: 1102). Quarantine enforced.
ana: tagging partner-ops for takedown and archive. please remove public object and send access logs.
sec-oncall: quick triage plan: 1) confirm KMS decrypts for ci-wrap in last 48h, 2) list Vault unwraps, 3) isolate runner if from infra, 4) prepare key rotation and token revokes.
ops: quarantined runner ci-runner-22 and stopped further artifacts from that agent.
leo: commands I'll run: `vault list auth/token/accessors` then `vault token lookup -accessor <accessor>` filtering for display_name matching ci-runner. also `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName:Decrypt' --filter='resource.labels.cryptoKey:ci-wrap' --freshness=2d`
maya: I grepped recent artifacts and found two more hits in builds 1098 and 1101. attaching hashes to INF-2026-361.
sec-oncall: creating new key version for ci-wrap now. do NOT unwrap any wrapped tokens until we confirm scope. we'll rewrap where necessary after rotation.
ana: partner confirmed removal and uploaded S3 access logs to secure-share (archive id arc-1102).
ops: will revoke any tokens we identify by accessor. prefer `vault token revoke -accessor` to avoid accidental live-token issues.
leo: drafting RBAC changes: remove token/issue privileges from runners, create a dedicated wrap-only principal for CI, and add mandatory per-request audit logs for unwrap ops. will open PR.
sec-oncall: assigned owners: maya -> evidence & artifact hashes, ops -> runner isolation confirmation, leo -> revoke script + RBAC PR, ana -> partner takedown coordination + logs, sec-oncall -> KMS rotation + incident. keep thread updated. do not paste raw tokens here. :lock:
